summary: Surging U.S. payrolls — with the three-month private payroll gain hitting a three-year high — have killed rate-cut hopes and shifted market pricing toward Fed hikes, pressuring bonds and risk assets. Crypto deepened its rout on a separate set of shocks: Strategy's first disclosed bitcoin sale, over $3.2 billion in spot ETF outflows, and a large Mt. Gox wallet transfer rattled an already fragile market.
tweet: Half a million jobs in five months has risks to inflation replacing rate-cut hopes — while crypto's historic ETF exodus and forced liquidations keep digital assets deep in fear.
